description.value: BjornBar Cafe is a boutique bakery and café located inside the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel in North Vancouver's Lynnmour neighbourhood, one of three Lower Mainland locations of this local chain. The shop is best known for over 30 flavours of handmade dessert bars — from classic Nanaimo to adventurous Spumoni — alongside fresh pastries, lunch items, and specialty coffee. For cyclists on the North Shore, it offers a quality café stop in a hotel setting.
